use_case_summary: Small HR SaaS: build an in-app conversational assistant for employees (support-agent) and an internal doc search for policy documents
Volume: currently low (burst to ~200 QPS not expected in near term). Primary needs: sub-200ms latency for short queries, affordable per-token pricing.
Preference: hosted API for quick launch; keep everything in public cloud. They want clear guarantees that prompts are not used for model training and that retention can be set per-customer.
Security asks: SSO (SAML) for admin console, audit logs for API keys, ability to purge historical prompts on request (opt-out/erasure), and configurable retention TTL for request logs.
